progressAppend: R62 executed six deterministic same-multiset sequences through actual Three.js r186 SPZLoader and GaussianSplat. A corrected nearest-even sequential Half replay matched all six center values exactly, and the predeclared at-or-below-half-ULP count equaled exact stalls. Two targeted sequences each had 1260 stalls but differed by 0.0029296875 in actual Half output, rejecting the total count as a sufficient predictor. The first failed run also showed r186 DataUtils.toHalfFloat truncation is not a GPU Half-target rounding oracle. No independent physical root, universal threshold or Mother adoption was added.
nextGate: Test a predeclared per-channel signed propagated rounding-residual trace on deterministic mixed-color sequences. Require actual r186 Half/Float comparison and a same-summary counterexample search; do not define a universal asset or device threshold.
